description: Held-out micro-tasks — NEVER use for fine-tune. Quality bar: docs/CODE-QUALITY-STANDARD.md

tasks.prompt: Export isBlank(s) that returns true when s is null, undefined, or a string that is empty after trim. Throw TypeError for other types.
Export chunk(arr, size) that splits an array into contiguous subarrays of length size. Throw TypeError if arr is not an array. Throw RangeError if size is not a positive integer.
Write a labeled email input: label Email associated via for/id, input type=email name=email required. No inline scripts.
Write an unordered list with three items: Alpha, Beta, Gamma.
Render numbers 1 through 3 using #list 1..3 as i inside an unordered list. Escape each number with ?html.
Given boolean flag, print yes if true else no, escaped with ?html, inside a span.
